cover_headline: Sachin Tendulkar Invests in Recykal, Extending $23 Million Bridge Round
facts: Recykal's $23 million bridge round closed in June 2026
Recykal reported FY26 gross revenue of ₹1,498 crore, up 53.2%
Recykal has raised more than $60 million to date

quote.text: What drew me to Recykal was seeing how technology was being used to solve an everyday problem. Recykal's mission to use technology to drive behavioural change across one billion people is what really connected with me.
quote.speaker: Sachin Tendulkar

end.headline: Sachin Tendulkar Invests in Recykal, Extending $23 Million Bridge Round
end.line: Tendulkar joins the Hyderabad waste-management platform as a strategic investor for an undisclosed amount.
